note: Provenance for the witness-market pack. Like packs/mcp-audit-trail/v0.1 and packs/bedrock-openai-audit/v0.1, the artifacts in THIS pack are authored in this repository: a public-safe, synthetic witness-market scenario (a WitnessServiceOffer, a WitnessRequest, and a WitnessResult from witness_market.py) and the SRS envelope receipt deterministically built from it. They are not copied from any private corpus or external repository. The subject_receipt_digest carried by the scenario is itself a SYNTHETIC placeholder digest, not a real receipt.

validates_against.note: The canonical SRS envelope schema and validator are the artifacts already vendored/reconciled in this repo; this pack does not re-vendor or edit them.

artifacts.role: forbidden-drift fixture (hoists the witness result's status as a top-level verdict instead of leaving it under extensions.garp.body.result.status)

market_contracts.loaded_by: tools/build_receipt.py and tools/check_invariant_guard.py via importlib file-path loading (no sys.path/cwd dependence)
market_contracts.authority_truth_effect_posture: WitnessServiceOffer, WitnessRequest, and WitnessResult structurally lack any authority_effect/truth_effect field -- non-authority is expressed by the fields' absence, never by a field pinned to "none". witness_market.reject_authority_injection() fails closed if untrusted input tries to smuggle one of those keys (or trusted/authorized/admitted/standing) in.
market_contracts.rule: witness_offer_exists != witness_selected != receipt_observed != receipt_valid != action_authorized != result_true; witness count never substitutes for verification or admission.
